plan.goal: Generate and triage at most one compact de novo soluble protein candidate using lightweight sequence, structure, and QC evidence.
assumptions: An unconditional single-chain de novo backbone workflow is acceptable because no target, motif, ligand, or template was provided.
A compact monomeric design is approximated by generating only one candidate and relying on the design tool's short-protein/default scaffold settings rather than a user-specified residue count.
Solubility and developability are assessed with lightweight sequence/QC signals and basic structure analysis rather than an additional expensive refolding or experimental validation step.
